text: No, not all of the 2021 loss was within the pine plantation. The evidence shows that out of the total 81.3 hectares of tree-cover loss, 68.1 hectares (84%) occurred in the planted pine forest (*Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*). The remaining 13.2 hectares (16%) were outside the mapped forest area, suggesting they may have occurred in non-forested or unclassified land. While the majority of the loss was in the pine plantation, a portion occurred beyond its boundaries.
